title: ModelInfo
description: Metadata for a single AI model as produced by the bestiary CLI JSON formatter.

Provider.description: Organization that hosts or publishes the model (e.g. "anthropic").

RawFamily.description: Raw API family field verbatim as returned by the upstream API (e.g. "claude-opus", "gemini-flash").

Family.description: Canonical family identifier extracted from RawFamily (or inferred from ID when RawFamily is empty). Populated at codegen time.

Variant.description: Variant suffix extracted from RawFamily (e.g. "opus-4", "pro", "flash"). Empty when the model has no variant. Populated at codegen time.

Version.description: Model version extracted from the family string (e.g. "4.5" for claude-opus-4-5, "2.5" for gemini-2.5-flash). Empty when the model has no separable version. Populated at codegen time.

Date.description: Release date extracted from the model ID or ReleaseDate field in YYYY-MM-DD format. Empty when no date is found. Populated at codegen time.

Modifier.description: List of known trailing tokens extracted from the model ID that carry semantic meaning beyond family/variant/version/date (e.g. ["thinking"], ["vision","instruct"]). Stored in deterministic canonical order (capability > speed > format/stage, alpha fallback). null when no known modifier is found. Widened from string to array of strings for lossless multi-modifier capture.

ContextWindow.description: Maximum number of tokens the model can process in a single request.

MaxOutput.description: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response.

Reasoning.description: Whether the model supports chain-of-thought or extended reasoning.

ToolCall.description: Whether the model supports tool/function calling.

Attachment.description: Whether the model supports file attachments.

Temperature.description: Whether the model exposes a temperature parameter.

StructuredOutput.description: Whether the model supports structured JSON output.

Interleaved.description: Polymorphic capability for interleaved reasoning. Supported indicates whether the capability is active; Config holds optional configuration (e.g. {"field": "reasoning_details"}).

Supported.description: Whether the interleaved capability is enabled.

Config.description: Optional capability configuration key-value pairs, or null if not applicable.

OpenWeights.description: Whether the model weights are publicly available.

CostInputPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million input tokens, or null if unknown.

CostOutputPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million output tokens, or null if unknown.

CostReasoningPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million reasoning tokens, or null if unknown.

CostCacheReadPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million cache-read tokens, or null if unknown.

CostCacheWritePerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million cache-write tokens, or null if unknown.

ReleaseDate.description: Model release date string as provided by the upstream API (e.g. "2024-01-01").

Knowledge.description: Knowledge cutoff date string as provided by the upstream API.

Modalities.description: Input and output modalities supported by the model.

LastSynced.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when this model record was last fetched from the upstream API.

Host.description: Serving host / backend infrastructure that runs this model instance, distinct from Provider (e.g. "azure", "aws"). A per-instance attribute that never participates in entity identity. Empty string when unknown or when the provider serves the model directly. Added in schema 0.1.0; optional for backward compatibility with 0.0.x records.

Lineage.description: Derivation edges from this model to its parent model(s) (finetune, merge, distillation, etc.). null when the model is a base model or no curated lineage is known. Added in schema 0.1.0; optional for backward compatibility with 0.0.x records.

ParamSize.description: Canonical parameter-size token for this model instance (e.g. "70b", "8b", "0.5b"). Empty string when the size is unknown or not applicable. Participates in entity identity via the #size segment of EntityRef.String(). Optional; absent for models without curated size data.

QuantVRAM.description: Per-quantization weight and VRAM footprint rows for this model instance. null when no quantization data is available. Populated at codegen time from curated data; live-sync rows carry null.

Source.description: Data source that provided this model row (e.g. "models.dev", "ollama"). Empty string (DataSourceNone) on live-sync rows; populated at codegen time from curated ingest data.

ModelRef.title: ModelRef
ModelRef.description: The canonical identity of a model. The 7-field tuple (ID, Provider, RawFamily, Family, Variant, Version, Date) is the stable anchor for cross-provider queries, canonical formatting, and the normalization pipeline.

ID.description: Original API model identifier (e.g. "claude-opus-4-20250514"). Corresponds to the ModelID type in Go.

Provider.description: Organization that hosts or publishes the model (e.g. "anthropic").

RawFamily.description: API family field verbatim as returned by the upstream API (e.g. "claude-opus").

Family.description: Canonical family identifier after normalization (e.g. "claude"). Empty if not yet normalized.

Variant.description: Canonical variant suffix (e.g. "opus", "sonnet", "haiku"). Empty when the model has no variant.

Version.description: Model version extracted from the family string (e.g. "4.5" for claude-opus-4-5, "2.5" for gemini-2.5-flash). Empty when the model has no separable version.

Date.description: Release date in YYYY-MM-DD format extracted from the model ID. Empty if none was found.

Modifier.description: List of known trailing tokens extracted from the model ID that carry semantic meaning (e.g. ["thinking"], ["vision","instruct"]), in canonical order. null when none. Widened from string to array of strings to match ModelRef.Modifier []string.

Host.description: Serving host / backend that runs this instance (e.g. "azure"), distinct from Provider. Per-instance attribute, never part of identity. Empty string when unknown. Added in schema 0.1.0; optional for backward compatibility.

EntityRef.title: EntityRef
EntityRef.description: Canonical identity of a model entity: the tuple (Family, Variant, Version, ParamSize) plus identity-class modifiers. Version is the identity version, NOT a release date (EntityRef has no Date field). ParamSize is the canonical parameter-size token and is part of identity. Modifier holds only identity-class modifiers, in canonical order. Its String() form family[/variant][@version][#paramsize]{identity-mods} is the comparable entity key; per-instance attributes never appear in it.

Variant.description: Canonical variant suffix. Empty when the entity has no variant.

Version.description: Identity version (e.g. "4.5", "3.1"). Empty when the entity has no separable version. This is NOT a release date.

ParamSize.description: Canonical parameter-size token (e.g. "70b", "8b", "0.5b"). Part of entity identity via the #size segment of EntityRef.String(): "llama@3.3#70b{instruct}" and "llama@3.3#8b{instruct}" are distinct entities. Empty when size is unknown — the #segment is then omitted so existing keys stay byte-identical. Added in schema 0.2.0; optional for backward compatibility.

Modifier.description: Identity-class modifiers only, in canonical order. null when none.

DerivationKind.title: DerivationKind
DerivationKind.description: How a model was derived from its parent(s): the edge label on a lineage relationship. Serializes as a lowercase text string via encoding.TextMarshaler.

x-enum-descriptions.finetune: Parameters further trained on additional data.
x-enum-descriptions.merge: Weights combined from two or more parent models (>= 2 parents).
x-enum-descriptions.distillation: A smaller student model trained to mimic a larger teacher.
x-enum-descriptions.quantized: A lower-precision copy of a parent model.
x-enum-descriptions.adapter: A parameter-efficient adapter (e.g. LoRA) over a base model.

LineageEdge.title: LineageEdge
LineageEdge.description: One directed derivation relationship: this model was derived from Parent via technique Kind. A model with multiple parents (e.g. a merge) carries multiple LineageEdges.

Parent.description: The parent entity this model was derived from.

Kind.description: The derivation technique relating this model to Parent.

CanonicalScheme.title: CanonicalScheme
CanonicalScheme.description: Identifies the string serialization format for a ModelRef. Controls how model identity is expressed as a string (e.g. for CLI output, SBOM generation, or HuggingFace Hub lookups).

x-enum-descriptions.canonical: Slash-separated canonical form: <provider>/<family>/<variant>@<date>. Variant and date segments are omitted when empty. Falls back to <provider>/<raw-id> when Family is empty.
x-enum-descriptions.huggingface: HuggingFace Hub form: <provider>/<raw-id>. Matches the repo-id used by the HuggingFace Hub API.
x-enum-descriptions.raw: Original API model ID verbatim (ModelRef.ID as a string).

AcceptabilityRating.title: AcceptabilityRating
AcceptabilityRating.description: Classifies a Designation by its acceptability status, following ISO 1087 terminology principles. All designations generated in the normalization epoch default to 'admitted'. Promotion to 'preferred' and assignment of 'deprecated' are deferred to a follow-up curation epoch.

x-enum-descriptions.admitted: Default rating. The designation is recognized and may be used, but is not the preferred form.
x-enum-descriptions.preferred: The designation is the recommended form. No designations are promoted to Preferred in the current epoch.
x-enum-descriptions.deprecated: The designation is no longer recommended. No designations are deprecated in the current epoch.

Designation.title: Designation
Designation.description: Pairs a model identity string with its serialization scheme, hosting provider, and acceptability rating. A single ModelRef may have multiple Designations: a canonical form, a raw API ID form, and optionally provider-specific alias forms.

Value.description: The serialized model identifier under the given Scheme.

Scheme.description: The serialization scheme used to produce Value.

Provider.description: The hosting provider associated with this designation. For cross-scheme designations (e.g. raw) the Provider is the original model's hosting provider.

Rating.description: Classifies acceptability. All epoch-generated designations are 'admitted'; promotion is deferred.

QuantVRAM.title: QuantVRAM
QuantVRAM.description: Per-quantization weight and VRAM footprint for one quantization variant of a model. WeightsBytes is the ground-truth ingested GGUF file size. VRAMBytes = WeightsBytes + KV-cache at VRAMContextTokens (model max context). VRAMEstimatePartial is true when the KV term was excluded because arch-facts (Layers/KVHeads/HeadDim) were absent.

Quant.description: Parsed quantization type. Serializes as a lowercase string via encoding.TextMarshaler.

QuantRaw.description: Verbatim quantization token from the source data, always populated for every row. Preserves the original casing exactly as it appeared in the source (e.g. "Q4_K_M" from an Ollama file_type field). Never empty when a row is present.

WeightsBytes.description: Ingested GGUF file size in bytes — the ground-truth weights footprint. 0 when unknown.

VRAMBytes.description: Estimated total VRAM in bytes: WeightsBytes + KV-cache at VRAMContextTokens. Equals WeightsBytes when VRAMEstimatePartial is true. 0 when unknown.

VRAMContextTokens.description: Context window in tokens used to compute VRAMBytes (the model-max context). 0 when unknown.

Layers.description: Number of transformer layers. 0 when unknown.

KVHeads.description: Number of KV-attention heads (GQA-aware). 0 when unknown.

HeadDim.description: Embedding width per attention head (elements per head). 0 when unknown.

VRAMEstimatePartial.description: True when the KV-cache term was excluded from VRAMBytes because at least one of Layers, KVHeads, or HeadDim is zero. Callers must check this flag before treating VRAMBytes as a full estimate.

Quantization.title: Quantization
Quantization.description: The quantization scheme applied to a model's weights, identified by its canonical lowercase wire name. Serializes as a string via encoding.TextMarshaler (case-insensitive on unmarshal). "none" is the unquantized zero value; "other" is the fail-safe bucket for a recognized-but-unmapped tag. The GGUF/llama.cpp families (q*/iq*/f16/bf16/f32) carry an authoritative bits-per-weight; the reserved HF-ecosystem members (awq/gptq/int8/int4) are config-dependent and reserved for a later ingest.

x-enum-descriptions.none: Unquantized zero value: no quantization format specified.
x-enum-descriptions.q4_0: Legacy GGUF 4-bit block quant, scheme 0; ~4.5 bpw (llama.cpp).
x-enum-descriptions.q4_1: Legacy GGUF 4-bit block quant, scheme 1; ~5.0 bpw (llama.cpp).
x-enum-descriptions.q5_0: Legacy GGUF 5-bit block quant, scheme 0; ~5.5 bpw (llama.cpp).
x-enum-descriptions.q5_1: Legacy GGUF 5-bit block quant, scheme 1; ~6.0 bpw (llama.cpp).
x-enum-descriptions.q8_0: Legacy GGUF 8-bit block quant, scheme 0; 8.5 bpw (llama.cpp).
x-enum-descriptions.awq: Reserved HF-ecosystem: Activation-aware Weight Quantization (4-bit); bpw config-dependent.
x-enum-descriptions.gptq: Reserved HF-ecosystem: GPTQ post-training quantization (3/4/8-bit); bpw config-dependent.
x-enum-descriptions.int8: Reserved HF-ecosystem: bitsandbytes 8-bit integer; bpw config-dependent.
x-enum-descriptions.int4: Reserved HF-ecosystem: bitsandbytes 4-bit integer; bpw config-dependent.
x-enum-descriptions.other: Fail-safe bucket for a recognized-but-unmapped quantization tag; raw token carried on the instance.

ProviderInstance.title: ProviderInstance
ProviderInstance.description: A single concrete offering of an entity: one (provider, host) serving of a model, with its instance-specific pricing, limits, and ingest provenance. Many ProviderInstances roll up into one Entity. The fields here are the per-instance ATTRIBUTES — they vary across instances of the same entity and so are excluded from EntityRef.

ID.description: Original API model identifier for this instance.

Provider.description: Organization that hosts or publishes this instance (e.g. "anthropic").

Host.description: Serving host / backend that runs this instance (e.g. "azure"), distinct from Provider. Empty string when unknown or served directly.

CostInputPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million input tokens, or null if unknown.

CostOutputPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million output tokens, or null if unknown.

ContextWindow.description: Maximum number of tokens this instance can process in a single request.

MaxOutput.description: Maximum number of tokens this instance can generate in a single response.

QuantVRAM.description: Per-quantization weight and VRAM footprint rows for this instance. null when no quantization data is available for this row. Added in schema 0.2.0.

Source.description: Data source that provided this row (e.g. "models.dev", "ollama"). Empty string (DataSourceNone) when no source is recorded. Added in schema 0.2.0.

CapabilityUnion.title: CapabilityUnion
CapabilityUnion.description: Aggregate capability view across all instances of an entity: each boolean is the OR over the corresponding per-instance capability (an entity supports a capability if ANY instance does). The zero value (all-false) is the identity-safe default for an entity with no instances.

Reasoning.description: Any instance supports chain-of-thought / extended reasoning.

ToolCall.description: Any instance supports tool / function calling.

Temperature.description: Any instance exposes a temperature parameter.

StructuredOutput.description: Any instance supports structured JSON output.

OpenWeights.description: Any instance has publicly available weights.

Entity.title: Entity
Entity.description: A model identity (Ref) together with every provider/host instance that serves it and the aggregate views derived from those instances. The unit returned by Entities() / EntityByTuple(). Range fields summarize the instances: PriceInputRange / PriceOutputRange are [min,max] over the NON-nil instance costs ({null,null} when every cost is nil); ContextRange / MaxOutputRange are [min,max] over instance context / max-output.

Ref.description: The canonical identity of this entity.

Instances.description: Every provider/host instance that serves this identity. null when the entity has no instances.

Lineage.description: Derivation edges from this entity to its parent(s). null when the entity is a base model or no curated lineage is known.

Providers.description: Distinct providers serving this entity. null when none.

Hosts.description: Distinct serving hosts for this entity. null when none.

PriceInputRange.description: [min,max] input cost in USD per million tokens over the NON-nil instance costs. Each bound is null when no instance has a known input cost.

PriceOutputRange.description: [min,max] output cost in USD per million tokens over the NON-nil instance costs. Each bound is null when no instance has a known output cost.

ContextRange.description: [min,max] context window in tokens over the instances.

MaxOutputRange.description: [min,max] max-output in tokens over the instances.

Capabilities.description: Aggregate (OR-over-instances) capability view for this entity.

Sources.description: Derived, sorted set of data sources attesting this entity's instances. Always contains at least "models.dev" for catalog entities. A read projection over the EntitySource join table, not a source of truth. Added in schema 0.2.0.

DataSource.title: DataSource
DataSource.description: A BCNF dimension row identifying a data source that provides model records to the registry (e.g. the models.dev API or the Ollama registry). URI is a second candidate key (UNIQUE) and is the single home for the source's location — it is NOT duplicated onto DatasetIngested.

ID.description: Stable source identifier (e.g. "models.dev", "ollama"). The primary key.

URI.description: Canonical location of the source (e.g. its API or registry URL). A second candidate key — UNIQUE across data sources.

CanonicalName.description: Human-readable display name for the source.

DatasetIngested.title: DatasetIngested
DatasetIngested.description: BCNF fact row recording the single current ingest of a data source (PK = SourceID, replace-on-refresh). It carries NO uri property: the URI is a transitive dependency on SourceID and lives only on DataSource, obtained by FK join. IngestedAt is a committed snapshot from the curated data, never a codegen wall-clock stamp (determinism).

SourceID.description: The DataSource this ingest belongs to (FK to DataSource.ID). The primary key — one current ingest per source.

IngestedAt.description: Timestamp of the ingest, a committed snapshot from the curated data (not a codegen wall-clock stamp).

ParserSchema.description: Parser/schema version under which the ingest was parsed.

EntitySource.title: EntitySource
EntitySource.description: A BCNF join-table row attesting that an entity is provided by a data source (composite PK = (EntityKey, SourceID)). The many-to-many relation between entities and data sources; Entity.Sources is its denormalized sorted read projection.

EntityKey.description: The entity key (EntityRef.String()) attested by SourceID. FK to a real entity.

SourceID.description: The data source attesting EntityKey (FK to DataSource.ID).
